name: pg-permissions-workspace
description: One entry point for the pg_permissions folder: the extension tests, the JS client (js/) and the docs site (site/). Run `npm run <script>` from this directory.

scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:docker
scripts.js:check: pnpm --dir js typecheck && pnpm --dir js test && pnpm --dir js build && pnpm --dir js check:exports
scripts.js:publish: npm run js:check && cd js && npm publish --access public
scripts.js:publish:dry: npm run js:check && cd js && npm publish --dry-run --ignore-scripts
scripts.check: npm run js:check && npm run docs:build
